units.source_text: 内大臣也觉得太唐突了，连忙说明：“

en.t: The Minister of the Interior also felt that this was far too abrupt, and hurriedly explained, "

units.source_text: 儿子将此幼女奉托太君抚养，自己一向不曾稍尽为父之责。

en.t: I entrusted this young daughter to Your Ladyship to raise, and I myself have never fulfilled even the slightest part of a father's duty.

units.source_text: 只因欲为长女争取女御地位，使她册立为后，用尽苦心，谁知遭到失败。

en.t: Because I was wholly absorbed in trying to win the position of imperial consort for my eldest daughter and have her made empress, I exhausted every effort, only to fail.

units.source_text: 儿子虽不抚育幼女，但深信太君教养有方，故甚放心。

en.t: Although I did not raise the young girl myself, I trusted deeply in Your Ladyship's good guidance and so felt quite at ease.

units.source_text: 岂料发生此意外之事，实甚遗憾！

en.t: Who could have expected such an unforeseen thing to happen? It is truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 夕雾虽然学识渊博，名重天下，但倘草草不择，就近攀姑表之亲，外人亦将讥笑为轻率。

en.t: Although Yugiri is deeply learned and famous throughout the world, if he were carelessly to take a close cousin as his match, outsiders would surely mock it as rash.

units.source_text: 即使微贱之人，亦不屑为此。

en.t: Even people of lowly rank would disdain to do such a thing.

units.source_text: 此事于夕雾亦甚不利。

en.t: This matter would be greatly disadvantageous to Yugiri as well.

units.source_text: 为夕雾计，不如另择高贵而非近亲之家，做个乘龙快婿，方为荣华之举。

en.t: For Yugiri's sake, it would be better to choose another noble family that is not closely related and make him an honored son-in-law there; that would be the truly glorious course.

units.source_text: 若就近结亲，源氏太政大臣亦必不喜。

en.t: If he forms a marriage so close at hand, the Genji Chancellor too will certainly not be pleased.

units.source_text: 太君即使欲令此二人结婚，亦不妨先将情由示知，以便多做准备，亦可使排场稍稍体面。

en.t: Even if Your Ladyship wished these two to marry, you might first have made the circumstances known, so that more preparations could be made and the ceremony given at least some proper dignity.

units.source_text: 如今任幼者之所欲为，不加管束，实在令人痛心啊！”

en.t: To let the young do as they please now, without any restraint, is truly painful to see."

units.source_text: 太君做梦也不曾想到，觉得此事实出意外，答道：“

en.t: The lady had never dreamed of such a thing and found it utterly unexpected, so she replied, "

units.source_text: 你这番话，亦属有理。

en.t: What you say does have reason in it.

units.source_text: 但我全然不知这两人有何打算。

en.t: But I know absolutely nothing of what these two may be planning.

units.source_text: 如果真有其事，我比你更加痛心呢。

en.t: If it is truly so, then I am even more distressed than you are.

units.source_text: 你要我与他们共负此罪，我心实甚不甘。

en.t: For you to make me share this blame with them is something my heart truly cannot accept.

units.source_text: 自从你将此小女交我抚养之后，我特别疼爱她。

en.t: Ever since you placed this little girl in my care, I have loved her with special tenderness.

units.source_text: 凡你所不曾注意之事，我也独自仔细考虑，务求将她养成优秀之人。

en.t: In all the matters you did not attend to, I considered things carefully on my own, striving to raise her into an excellent person.

units.source_text: 二人年龄如此幼稚，而为长上者溺爱徇情，若谓听其苟且结合，则万无此理！

en.t: When the two are still so young, for their elders to indulge them out of affection and allow them to join themselves carelessly would be utterly unreasonable.

units.source_text: 我且问你：你是从谁口中听来的？

en.t: Let me ask you this: from whose mouth did you hear it?

units.source_text: 轻信恶人之言而肆意责人，万万不可！

en.t: To lightly believe the words of malicious people and accuse others at will is absolutely unacceptable.

units.source_text: 倘无事实根据，岂非毁坏别人名誉么？”

en.t: If there is no factual basis, would that not be destroying another person's reputation?"

units.source_text: 内大臣答道：“

en.t: The Minister of the Interior answered, "

units.source_text: 不敢，决非毫无根据。

en.t: Not at all; it is certainly not without basis.

units.source_text: 尊处诸侍女皆在背后评议讥笑呢。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting in your household are discussing it behind your back and laughing scornfully.

units.source_text: 此事实甚遗憾，且又深可担心。”

en.t: This matter is truly regrettable, and it is also deeply worrying."

units.source_text: 说罢，告辞而去。

en.t: Having said this, he took his leave and departed.
